scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service canceled 34 days ago, which falls outside the standard 30-day refund policy.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Carlos Rodriguez and I'm 76. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?

Hello, Mr. Rodriguez. I appreciate you reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear about the confusion regarding your account. I would be happy to look into this for you. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your subscription?
Sure, my account number is 9982-4410 and the email is carlos.r@email.com.
Thank you for that information. For security purposes, could you please confirm the last four digits of the payment method on file and your current billing zip code?
The card ends in 4492 and my zip code is 90210.

Thank you, Mr. Rodriguez. I have successfully verified your account. I see the cancellation was processed 34 days ago. While our 'Service Agreement Section 4.2' states that refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of the charge, I can see you have been a loyal customer for over five years. I would like to make a one-time exception to our policy given your circumstances.
Oh, that would be wonderful. I really appreciate your help with this.

It is my pleasure. I have processed a full refund of $49.99 to your card ending in 4492. You should see the credit reflected on your statement within 3-5 business days depending on your bank. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that is everything. Thank you so much for your understanding.
You are very welcome! Thank you for choosing us, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.

resolution_summary: Agent verified account details and exercised discretionary authority to grant a one-time policy exception for a refund outside the 30-day window due to customer loyalty.
